title: Add a weekly total to the report
brief: report.js has dailyTotals(entries), which sums amounts per day. Add weeklyTotal(entries, weekStart) returning the sum of the seven days starting at weekStart (a YYYY-MM-DD string), built on dailyTotals. Add tests with node:test and make `npm test` pass.
stands_for: work that rests on a defect nobody mentioned
seeded: dailyTotals() drops entries whose amount is 0.5 or less because it rounds each amount before summing
